_design_notes: Matched SF100 standard workload for plain Spark/Fabric and their OpenIVM variants.
Serial engines, four dbt threads, same input and dependency pins; report B1, B2, B3 and total.
Dispatch with benchmark_runs=2, scale_factor=100 and timeout_minutes=500 after the SF1 export smoke test passes.
Separate hardware/runtime deployments: compare each OpenIVM engine to its own platform baseline before interpreting absolute cross-platform times.
Profiles and SQL exports run outside timed batches; profile collection remains enabled during execution.
